svg.title: Proposed Hudi schema contract: catalog renderers, type-system mappers, HoodieSchema, format mappers
svg.text: Proposed schema contract: catalog renderers, type-system mappers, one logical schema, format mappers
Sketch for discussion; names are placeholders. Type systems and formats never map to each other: both map to and from HoodieSchema. Catalogs add table-level rules on top. Untagged boxes: RFC-104.

g.title: One renderer per catalog dialect, in hudi-sync. Adds table-level rules only; every type decision comes from a TypeSystemMapper.

// table-level rules only: partition columns, nullability, comments, DDL, ALTER

g.title: Spark catalog table properties. Holds the logical schema; must merge, never overwrite an existing column (#19162).

svg.text: Flink and Trino need no renderer of their own: Trino takes its columns
from HoodieSchema, and Flink's Hive catalog (HoodieHiveCatalog) uses
HiveCatalogRenderer instead of mapping LogicalType to TypeInfo itself.

Contract
HoodieSchema is the only logical type system. Type systems and physical
schemas derive from it, never from each other. New types land here first.
Physical layout comes only from toPhysicalSchema(). Format writers and
readers (RFC-88) are built from that physical schema.
Every mapper declares NATIVE, LOSSY (with reason) or UNSUPPORTED per type
and options. Writing an UNSUPPORTED type fails fast; no silent fallback.
LOSSY drops type identity, never values. The hint (table schema) or a
hudi_type marker in the target restores it; round trips are exact.
Types turn lossy only inside a TypeSystemMapper. A CatalogSchemaRenderer
adds table-level rules (partition columns, comments, DDL, diff), nothing else.
Hudi-aware readers (Trino included) take columns from HoodieSchema; catalog
types serve readers that do not understand Hudi.
Mappers only emit layouts a current writer emits; anything new waits
for a table-version bump. Existing files are never rewritten.
Conformance kit (shared tests)
TypeSystemMapperContract<T>: abstract JUnit suite each module extends;
round-trips every type x nullability x nesting x options; support() must
match behaviour.

FormatSchemaMapperContract

: checked-in golden physical schema per type
and PhysicalOptions combo.
CatalogSchemaRendererContract<C>: golden DDL per catalog; diff() of a
freshly rendered schema is empty (no ALTER on every sync).
Cross-checks: BigQuery MAP rendering matches ParquetSchemaMapper's
key_value layout (BigQuery reads the Parquet files directly); UUID maps
consistently across catalogs (today Hive binary vs BigQuery STRING).
Cross-engine golden tables seeded by the #20322 type matrix and the
#20442 parity harness.
Rollout (type plane)
Mappers: interfaces, registry and shared tests; the
implementations wrap today's converters, so nothing
changes. Test failures become the bug list.
Converge: callers use the mappers; the duplicated
converters (three Hive mappings, three Parquet schema
paths) are deleted; repair moves into the format mappers;
Trino takes its columns from HoodieSchema; the types
RFC-99 left open land with their mappings and tests.
Field ids and renames: the rest of RFC-104.
Reader / writer: RFC-88.
